blockBreak.label: block_break
blockBreak.help: A block is broken. Target: block ids.

entityDeath.label: entity_death
entityDeath.help: An entity dies. Target: entity ids.

fishing.label: fishing
fishing.help: A bobber catches something. No target.

piglinBarter.label: piglin_barter
piglinBarter.help: A piglin finishes bartering. No target.

container.label: container
container.help: A loot container is filled. Target: loot table ids.

archaeology.label: archaeology
archaeology.help: Suspicious sand or gravel is brushed. Target: loot table ids.

entityDrop.label: entity_drop
entityDrop.help: An entity drops an item (e.g. a chicken lays an egg). Target: entity ids.

harvest.label: harvest
harvest.help: A player harvests a block. Target: block ids.

blockShear.label: block_shear
blockShear.help: A player shears a block. Target: block ids.

entityShear.label: entity_shear
entityShear.help: A player shears an entity. Target: entity ids.

vault.label: vault
vault.help: A vault gives its reward. Target: loot table ids.

advancement.label: advancement
advancement.help: A player completes an advancement; the loot goes into the inventory. Target: advancement ids.

furnitureItem.label: furniture_item
furnitureItem.help: Drops the item the furniture was placed with.

item.label: item
item.help: The item it drops when the furniture has no item of its own.

empty.label: empty
empty.help: Drops nothing. Use it to give the other entries a chance to miss.

function.label: function
function.help: Runs functions instead of dropping an item.

lootTable.label: loot_table
lootTable.help: Drops the loot of another loot table.

alternatives.label: alternatives
alternatives.help: Drops the first child whose conditions hold.

ifElse.label: if_else
ifElse.help: Drops the first child whose conditions hold (a second name of alternatives).

applyBonus.label: apply_bonus
applyBonus.help: Adds items for each level of an enchantment, such as Fortune.

formula.label: formula
formula.help: How the level turns into extra items.

type.label: type
type.help: ore_drops: like vanilla ores. binomial_with_bonus_count: like vanilla crops.

explosionDecay.label: explosion_decay
explosionDecay.help: Lets an explosion destroy some of the items.

limitCount.label: limit_count
limitCount.help: Keeps the number of items between min and max.

applyData.label: apply_data
applyData.help: Changes the data of the items.

data.label: data
data.help: Item data as YAML, like the data of an item.
